question: 'Shantaram' is a novel written by ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gregory David Roberts**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Gregory David Roberts is an **Australian author**.
 
• He wrote the **Shantaram novel in 2003**.
 
• It is a story of the life of the author escaping from a maximum security prison and travelling with a fake passport arriving in Bombay, India.
 
• The book's title is named after his best friend's mother gave him, which means **Man of Peace**.
